Question: Let \(i=\sqrt{-1}.\) For \(n\ge1,\) define a sequence of complex numbers by \[ \begin{aligned} z_1&=0,\\ z_{n+1}&=z_n^2+i. \end{aligned} \] In the complex plane, how far from the origin is \(z_{111}?\)
